name: Ena Vrisha
residence: Herding District, near the Vrisha pastures
personality: highly observant of small physical changes
patient with animals, blunt with people
keeps meticulous mental records of illness patterns
uneasy discussing things she can't explain
trusted by herders more than by officials
daily_routine: examining zebu cattle and water buffalo for illness
treating wounds and parasites with herbal remedies
tracking which pastures produce sicker animals
coordinating with Roka on herd movement to healthier ground
training Kiri in basic animal first aid
recording unusual animal behavior near the Old Canal Bed

goals.public_goal: Keep the town's cattle and buffalo healthy across all seasons
goals.hidden_goal: Map which pastures have produced unexplained illness clusters over the years
goals.deep_goal: Determine whether the illness clusters connect to the same land changes the farmers and kiln-workers describe

beliefs: Animals show sickness in a landscape before people notice it in themselves
A pattern repeated three times is not coincidence
The pastures nearest the Old Canal Bed are not as safe as the Assembly claims
Herbal treatment only works if you understand the true cause, not just the symptom
People dismiss animal instinct until it's proven right, then forget it was ever in doubt
